followups: LiveWorkspacePanel.readContext: the generation guard only changes when the selected run or scope changes. Two reads on the same run can therefore resolve out of order. A late invalid response can set actionError next to a newer validated exactContext, and a late valid response can set exactContext after a newer error. Add a per-read counter, e.g. `const read=++readSeq.current` checked together with the generation, so only the latest read sets context or error. Only same-run, already validated data is affected, so this does not block the change.

HandoffExport claims `allowedFiles`, `readableNodeIds`, `provider`, `model` and `budgetSeconds` are typed, but assertHandoffExport never checks them; the final cast asserts more than was validated. Either validate those fields (string[], string, number) or narrow the returned type to the fields actually checked, with the rest as unknown. Otherwise a future consumer might trust unvalidated fields.
